examples.en: Her agitation was obvious when she heard the bad news.
examples.zh: 她聽到壞消息時，激動的情緒非常明顯。

examples.en: The manager noticed some agitation among the staff before the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理注意到會議前員工之間有些不安。

examples.en: Public agitation over the price increase grew last week.
examples.zh: 民眾對漲價的不滿情緒上週持續升高。

examples.en: Our school offers a class about AI and robots.
examples.zh: 我們學校開了一門關於人工智慧與機器人的課。

examples.en: The company uses AI to answer simple customer questions.
examples.zh: 這家公司用人工智慧回答簡單的客戶問題。

examples.en: Many people wonder how AI will change office work.
examples.zh: 許多人好奇人工智慧會如何改變辦公室的工作。

examples.en: The mayor's aide handed her a list of today's meetings.
examples.zh: 市長的助理遞給她一份今天的會議清單。

examples.en: A teaching aide helps the students with their reading.
examples.zh: 教學助理協助學生閱讀。

examples.en: He works as an aide to a member of the city council.
examples.zh: 他擔任一位市議員的幕僚。

examples.en: The airlift brought food and water to the isolated village.
examples.zh: 這次空運把食物和水送到了與外界隔絕的村莊。

examples.en: An airlift was the only way to deliver the medicine in time.
examples.zh: 空運是及時送達藥品的唯一方法。

examples.en: The government organized an airlift after the flood.
examples.zh: 水災過後，政府安排了空運救援。

examples.en: The army will airlift supplies to the mountain area.
examples.zh: 軍方將空運物資到山區。

examples.en: They airlifted the injured hiker to a hospital.
examples.zh: 他們把受傷的登山客空運到醫院。

examples.en: Relief teams airlifted blankets to the families in need.
examples.zh: 救援團隊把毛毯空運給有需要的家庭。

examples.en: The number of students who sleep late is alarming.
examples.zh: 晚睡的學生人數多得令人擔憂。

examples.en: Doctors noticed an alarming change in his test results.
examples.zh: 醫生注意到他的檢查結果有令人擔憂的變化。

examples.en: The lake is shrinking at an alarming rate.
examples.zh: 這座湖正以驚人的速度縮小。

examples.en: The company denied the allegation of cheating customers.
examples.zh: 公司否認欺騙顧客的指控。

examples.en: The teacher took the allegation seriously and began an inquiry.
examples.zh: 老師認真看待這項指控，並展開調查。

examples.en: There is no evidence to support the allegation.
examples.zh: 沒有證據支持這項指控。

examples.en: The alleged thief was questioned by the police.
examples.zh: 這名涉嫌的竊賊接受了警方詢問。

examples.en: The alleged mistake in the report has been corrected.
examples.zh: 報告中據稱的錯誤已經更正。

examples.en: Officials are looking into the alleged problem at the factory.
examples.zh: 官員正在調查工廠據稱存在的問題。

examples.en: This medicine can alleviate the pain in your knee.
examples.zh: 這種藥可以減輕你膝蓋的疼痛。

examples.en: More buses will alleviate the traffic problem downtown.
examples.zh: 增加公車班次將緩解市中心的塞車問題。

examples.en: A short walk may alleviate your stress.
examples.zh: 散個步或許能緩解你的壓力。

examples.en: The allied countries signed a trade agreement.
examples.zh: 這些同盟國簽署了一份貿易協定。

examples.en: Allied forces worked together to protect the coast.
examples.zh: 聯軍合作保衛海岸。

examples.en: Biology and chemistry are allied fields of study.
examples.zh: 生物學與化學是相關的研究領域。

examples.en: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.
examples.zh: 青銅是銅和錫的合金。

examples.en: This bike frame is made of a light alloy.
examples.zh: 這輛腳踏車的車架是用輕質合金製成的。

examples.en: The lab is testing a new alloy for airplane parts.
examples.zh: 實驗室正在測試一種用於飛機零件的新合金。

examples.en: Workers alloy the two metals at a high temperature.
examples.zh: 工人在高溫下把這兩種金屬熔成合金。

examples.en: The factory alloys iron with a little carbon.
examples.zh: 工廠把鐵與少量的碳熔成合金。

examples.en: They alloyed silver and copper to make the coins harder.
examples.zh: 他們把銀與銅製成合金，讓硬幣更堅硬。

examples.en: The travelers fell into an ambush on the mountain road.
examples.zh: 旅人在山路上遭到了埋伏。

examples.en: The soldiers set up an ambush near the bridge.
examples.zh: 士兵們在橋邊設下埋伏。

examples.en: The movie begins with an ambush in a dark forest.
examples.zh: 這部電影從黑暗森林裡的一場伏擊開始。

examples.en: The wolves ambush their prey in the tall grass.
examples.zh: 狼群在高高的草叢中埋伏獵物。

examples.en: Reporters tried to ambush the singer outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 記者試圖在旅館外攔堵那位歌手。

examples.en: The knights planned to ambush the enemy at dawn.
examples.zh: 騎士們計畫在黎明時伏擊敵軍。

examples.en: The committee approved an amendment to the school rules.
examples.zh: 委員會通過了校規的一項修正案。

examples.en: She made a small amendment to the contract before signing it.
examples.zh: 她在簽約前對合約做了一處小修改。

examples.en: The amendment will take effect next year.
examples.zh: 這項修正案明年開始生效。

examples.en: He bought her a gift to make amends for being late.
examples.zh: 他買了禮物給她，彌補自己遲到的過錯。

examples.en: The company offered to make amends to the angry customers.
examples.zh: 公司願意對憤怒的顧客做出補償。

examples.en: I want to make amends for my rude words.
examples.zh: 我想為我無禮的言詞賠不是。

examples.en: Our new neighbor is an amiable man who always says hello.
examples.zh: 我們的新鄰居是個和藹可親的人，總是主動打招呼。

examples.en: The amiable guide made the tourists feel welcome.
examples.zh: 親切的導遊讓遊客感到賓至如歸。

examples.en: She gave an amiable smile to everyone in the room.
examples.zh: 她對房間裡的每個人露出友善的微笑。

examples.en: The two companies reached an amicable agreement.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司達成了友好的協議。

examples.en: They had an amicable talk about sharing the cost.
examples.zh: 他們友好地談了費用分攤的問題。

examples.en: The couple stayed on amicable terms after the divorce.
examples.zh: 這對夫妻離婚後仍維持和睦的關係。

examples.en: The museum has a collection of old ammunition.
examples.zh: 博物館收藏了一批舊彈藥。

examples.en: The soldiers checked how much ammunition was left.
examples.zh: 士兵們清點還剩下多少彈藥。

examples.en: The guide explained how ammunition was stored in the old fort.
examples.zh: 導覽員解說了舊要塞裡彈藥的存放方式。

examples.en: The government announced an amnesty for the prisoners.
examples.zh: 政府宣布對囚犯實施大赦。

examples.en: The library offered an amnesty for overdue books.
examples.zh: 圖書館對逾期未還的書籍提供免罰期。

examples.en: Several groups asked for an amnesty for the workers.
examples.zh: 幾個團體要求對這些工人特赦。

examples.en: Our teacher began the lesson with a funny anecdote.
examples.zh: 老師用一則有趣的軼事開始上課。

examples.en: He told an anecdote about his first day at work.
examples.zh: 他講了一則關於他第一天上班的趣聞。

examples.en: The book is full of short anecdotes about famous artists.
examples.zh: 這本書裡滿是關於知名藝術家的短篇軼事。

examples.en: The angler waited quietly by the river all morning.
examples.zh: 那位釣客整個早上都安靜地在河邊等待。

examples.en: Many anglers visit this lake in the spring.
examples.zh: 許多釣客在春天來到這座湖。

examples.en: An old angler showed the boy how to tie a hook.
examples.zh: 一位老釣客教那個男孩怎麼綁釣鉤。

examples.en: Antarctic ice is melting faster than before.
examples.zh: 南極的冰比以前融化得更快。

examples.en: Scientists at the Antarctic station study the weather.
examples.zh: 南極站的科學家研究當地的天氣。

examples.en: Penguins live in the Antarctic region.
examples.zh: 企鵝生活在南極地區。

examples.en: We moved the antenna to get a clearer picture on the TV.
examples.zh: 我們移動了天線，讓電視畫面更清楚。

examples.en: The car's antenna was damaged in the storm.
examples.zh: 那輛車的天線在暴風雨中損壞了。

examples.en: An ant uses its antenna to feel the world around it.
examples.zh: 螞蟻用觸角感知周遭的環境。

examples.en: The body makes antibodies to fight a virus.
examples.zh: 人體會製造抗體來對抗病毒。

examples.en: A blood test can show whether you have the antibody.
examples.zh: 驗血可以得知你是否有這種抗體。

examples.en: The vaccine helps your body build antibodies.
examples.zh: 疫苗幫助你的身體產生抗體。

examples.en: Apartheid was a system of racial separation in South Africa.
examples.zh: 種族隔離是南非曾經實施的一種種族分離制度。

examples.en: Our history teacher talked about the end of apartheid.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師談到種族隔離政策的終結。

examples.en: Many people around the world spoke out against apartheid.
examples.zh: 世界各地許多人公開反對種族隔離政策。

examples.en: The poor food quality at the cafeteria appalled the parents.
examples.zh: 學生餐廳糟糕的餐點品質讓家長們震驚。

examples.en: It would appall me if anyone treated animals that way.
examples.zh: 如果有人那樣對待動物，我會很震驚。

examples.en: The mess in the kitchen appalled his mother.
examples.zh: 廚房的髒亂讓他的媽媽大為震驚。

examples.en: The weather was appalling during our trip.
examples.zh: 我們旅行期間的天氣糟透了。

examples.en: The hotel room was in an appalling condition.
examples.zh: 那間旅館房間的狀況糟糕透頂。

examples.en: She was shocked by the appalling noise from the street.
examples.zh: 她被街上駭人的噪音嚇了一跳。

examples.en: The students set up the apparatus for the science experiment.
examples.zh: 學生們為科學實驗架設了儀器。

examples.en: The gym has a new apparatus for balance training.
examples.zh: 健身房新增了一套平衡訓練的設備。

examples.en: The firefighters tested the breathing apparatus.
examples.zh: 消防員測試了呼吸裝置。

examples.en: You can find the full list of words in the appendix.
examples.zh: 你可以在附錄中找到完整的單字表。

examples.en: The report has an appendix with extra charts.
examples.zh: 這份報告有一個附錄，裡面有額外的圖表。

examples.en: He had his appendix removed at the hospital last week.
examples.zh: 他上週在醫院割除了闌尾。

examples.en: The teacher gave an honest appraisal of my essay.
examples.zh: 老師對我的作文做了誠實的評價。

examples.en: We asked an expert for an appraisal of the old painting.
examples.zh: 我們請專家鑑定那幅舊畫。

examples.en: Each employee has an annual appraisal with the manager.
examples.zh: 每位員工每年都要和經理進行一次考績面談。

examples.en: There was an appreciable difference between the two phones.
examples.zh: 這兩支手機之間有明顯的差異。

examples.en: The new bus line saved us an appreciable amount of time.
examples.zh: 新的公車路線替我們省下了可觀的時間。

examples.en: Sales showed no appreciable growth last month.
examples.zh: 上個月的銷售額沒有明顯的成長。

examples.en: She felt some apprehension before the job interview.
examples.zh: 她在工作面試前感到有些不安。

examples.en: The students waited with apprehension for their test scores.
examples.zh: 學生們憂心忡忡地等待考試成績。

examples.en: His apprehension grew as the plane began to shake.
examples.zh: 飛機開始搖晃時，他的憂慮越來越深。

examples.en: She has a natural aptitude for languages.
examples.zh: 她對語言有天生的天分。

examples.en: The school gave every student an aptitude test.
examples.zh: 學校讓每位學生做了性向測驗。

examples.en: His aptitude for math helped him win the contest.
examples.zh: 他的數學天賦幫助他贏得了比賽。

examples.en: The teacher said the seating order was not arbitrary.
examples.zh: 老師說座位的順序不是隨意安排的。

examples.en: It was an arbitrary decision with no clear reason.
examples.zh: 那是一個沒有明確理由的武斷決定。

examples.en: The company was criticized for its arbitrary rules.
examples.zh: 這家公司因為其任意訂定的規則而受到批評。

examples.en: The ball moved in a high arc over the net.
examples.zh: 球以一道高高的弧線越過球網。

examples.en: A rainbow formed a bright arc across the sky.
examples.zh: 彩虹在天空中劃出一道明亮的弧形。

examples.en: Draw an arc with the compass on the paper.
examples.zh: 用圓規在紙上畫一道弧線。

examples.en: The old station is an architectural treasure.
examples.zh: 這座老車站是一件建築瑰寶。

examples.en: She studied architectural design at university.
examples.zh: 她在大學主修建築設計。

examples.en: Tourists admire the architectural beauty of the temple.
examples.zh: 遊客們欣賞這座寺廟的建築之美。

examples.en: Arctic winds made the town extremely cold.
examples.zh: 極寒的風讓這座小鎮冷得不得了。

examples.en: Polar bears live in the Arctic region.
examples.zh: 北極熊生活在北極地區。

examples.en: Scientists measure the Arctic ice every summer.
examples.zh: 科學家每年夏天都會測量北極的冰層。

examples.en: Few people live in the Arctic.
examples.zh: 很少有人住在北極地區。

examples.en: The Arctic is getting warmer every year.
examples.zh: 北極地區一年比一年暖和。

examples.en: The documentary was filmed in the Arctic.
examples.zh: 這部紀錄片是在北極地區拍攝的。

examples.en: The museum displays a knight's armor from the 1400s.
examples.zh: 博物館展出一套十五世紀騎士的盔甲。

examples.en: The truck is covered with heavy armor.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車覆蓋著厚重的裝甲。

examples.en: Some animals have natural armor to protect their bodies.
examples.zh: 有些動物擁有天然的盔甲來保護身體。

examples.en: Blood flows from the heart through the arteries.
examples.zh: 血液從心臟經過動脈流出。

examples.en: The doctor said one of his arteries was partly blocked.
examples.zh: 醫生說他有一條動脈部分阻塞。

examples.en: This road is the main artery of the city.
examples.zh: 這條路是這座城市的主要幹道。

examples.en: The museum keeps an ancient artifact in a glass case.
examples.zh: 博物館把一件古代文物放在玻璃櫃裡。

examples.en: Students dug up several artifacts at the old site.
examples.zh: 學生們在古蹟遺址挖出了幾件文物。

examples.en: This artifact is more than two thousand years old.
examples.zh: 這件文物已有兩千多年的歷史。

examples.en: The old fort displays artillery from the nineteenth century.
examples.zh: 這座舊要塞展示著十九世紀的大砲。

examples.en: The artillery was moved to a safer position.
examples.zh: 砲兵部隊被移到較安全的位置。

examples.en: Our history book has a chapter about artillery.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史課本有一章在談砲兵。

examples.en: The police tried to ascertain the cause of the fire.
examples.zh: 警方試圖查明火災的原因。

examples.en: Please ascertain the exact time of the meeting.
examples.zh: 請確認會議的準確時間。

examples.en: We called the hotel to ascertain whether rooms were available.
examples.zh: 我們打電話給旅館，確認是否還有空房。

examples.en: Many people ascribe his success to hard work.
examples.zh: 許多人把他的成功歸功於努力。

examples.en: The teacher ascribed the low scores to the difficult test.
examples.zh: 老師把低分歸因於考題太難。

examples.en: This poem is usually ascribed to a famous writer.
examples.zh: 這首詩通常被認為是一位著名作家的作品。

examples.en: Her aspiration is to become a doctor.
examples.zh: 她的志向是成為醫生。

examples.en: Students shared their aspirations for the future in class.
examples.zh: 學生們在課堂上分享了對未來的抱負。

examples.en: He has high aspirations for his small business.
examples.zh: 他對自己的小生意抱有很高的期望。

examples.en: The teacher gave us an assessment at the end of the unit.
examples.zh: 老師在單元結束時給了我們一次評量。

examples.en: The manager made an honest assessment of the project.
examples.zh: 經理對這個專案做了誠實的評估。

examples.en: A doctor's assessment is needed before you join the team.
examples.zh: 加入球隊前需要先經過醫生的評估。

examples.en: Our English teacher gave us a long assignment.
examples.zh: 我們的英文老師出了一份很長的作業。

examples.en: The reporter received a new assignment in Japan.
examples.zh: 那位記者接到了一項前往日本的新任務。

examples.en: Please hand in your assignment before Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五之前交作業。

examples.en: Young children assimilate new words very quickly.
examples.zh: 幼兒吸收新單字的速度非常快。

examples.en: It took the family a year to assimilate into the new town.
examples.zh: 這家人花了一年才融入新的小鎮。

examples.en: The body needs time to assimilate the nutrients in food.
examples.zh: 身體需要時間吸收食物中的養分。

senses.zh: 有把握的；確定的；自信的

examples.en: With the scholarship, her place at college is assured.
examples.zh: 有了獎學金，她的大學名額就確定了。

examples.en: He gave an assured answer to every question.
examples.zh: 他對每個問題都回答得很有自信。

examples.en: You can be assured that we will fix the problem.
examples.zh: 你可以放心，我們會解決這個問題。

examples.en: The family asked for asylum in a safe country.
examples.zh: 這家人向一個安全的國家申請庇護。

examples.en: The government granted asylum to the writer.
examples.zh: 政府給予那位作家庇護。

examples.en: Thousands of people sought asylum last year.
examples.zh: 去年有數千人尋求庇護。

examples.en: I stopped at the ATM to take out some cash.
examples.zh: 我在自動櫃員機停下來提了些現金。

examples.en: The ATM near the station is out of order again.
examples.zh: 車站附近的自動櫃員機又故障了。

examples.en: You can check your balance at any ATM.
examples.zh: 你可以在任何一台自動櫃員機查詢餘額。

examples.en: The history lesson was about an atrocity during the war.
examples.zh: 這堂歷史課談的是戰爭期間的一項暴行。

examples.en: Leaders around the world condemned the atrocity.
examples.zh: 世界各國領袖譴責這項暴行。

examples.en: The museum helps people remember the atrocities of the past.
examples.zh: 這間博物館幫助人們記住過去的暴行。

examples.en: Please read the attached file before the meeting.
examples.zh: 請在會議前閱讀附上的檔案。

examples.en: The boy is very attached to his grandmother.
examples.zh: 這個男孩非常依戀他的奶奶。

examples.en: The school has a small garden attached to it.
examples.zh: 這所學校附設了一座小花園。
